Name: AT - Market Coffee Maker
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KgJBxW8.png[/img]
[size=3]I love coffee, I also love the free coffee from the night market, their coffee maker is so cute that I made one to use at home together with a new rug, this mod goes really well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13249?tab=description]NPCs as Chests[/url]﻿ from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/80990398]sproggen[/url].
[/size][center][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/hNORhek.png[/img]﻿ [url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/author/concernedape/]ConcernedApe[/url] for the rug and coffee maker <3

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/135930628]Luan125gui[/url] for recolors :D
[left][/left][/size][/center][size=3][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/n2YpLy5.png[/img]﻿
1. Download this mod and Alternative Textures

2. Drop everything in the mods folder

3. Buy the paint bucket from Robin and use it on a coffee maker or old world rug

4.  Have fun!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/puE8kJD.png[/img] Buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/dollymods]coffee[/url] if you want to help me make more mods [img]https://i.imgur.com/puE8kJD.png[/img][/center][/size]
